events.title: Demo Update 9
events.summary: Added a dynamic sky with sunny, cloudy, and stormy weather, smooth weather transitions, and updated daytime and nighttime visuals.Rain and additional storm effects will be available in the full release.Bandits now attack the car when the player climbs onto it or reaches a location they cannot access.Fixed collision issues around bridges.Fixed bandits getting stuck and unexpectedly entering ragdoll.

events.title: Demo Update 8
events.summary: Added Xbox controller support.Added customizable key bindings.

events.title: Performance & macOS Update
events.summary: Improved chunk loading speed, fixing chunks loading too late on lower-end systems.Added macOS support for Apple Silicon M-series Macs.

events.title: Steering wheel support has been added!
events.summary: Steering wheel support has been added! Only the Logitech G29 is currently supported, as it’s the only device I’ve been able to test.The UI still needs some work, and I’ll be revisiting it in future updates.

events.title: Small Demo Update
events.summary: Sleep audio now plays only when confirming sleep, and interactions are blocked during sleep prompts.Vehicle engine audio now changes based on the installed engine.

events.title: Demo Update 5
events.summary: Fixed an issue where flat tires couldn't be picked up.Added a tutorial explaining how to break road barriers.Fixed several other minor bugs that weren't worth listing individually.Thanks to everyone in the community who has been reporting bugs and sharing feedback. It really helps us find issues faster and keep improving the demo.

events.title: Demo Update 4
events.summary: Parts now break and fall off when their condition reaches 0, except for engine parts.Made it easier to hit bandits.Fixed bandits sometimes teleporting to random positions while getting back up.Car doors now correctly affect how muffled the music sounds when listening from outside the car.Added an outline when adding oil or water.Fixed the game getting stuck if the player faints while the buy/sell UI is open.Reduced the building spawn rate per chunk.Hunger now decreases slightly slower.Fixed miss

events.title: Demo Update 3
events.summary: Fixed gas stations sometimes spawning too high for the car to reach.Fixed the player moving faster when walking diagonally.Car lights can now be toggled with L.Fixed part information remaining on screen after opening the inventory.Fixed part information not updating after changing a part’s values, such as adding oil or water.Added an indicator to spray paint cans.Fixed an issue where talking to the musician NPC during the tutorial could prevent the tutorial from progressing.Added drifting with t

events.title: Demo Update 2
events.summary: Made changes to address an issue where the tutorial parking objective could fail to complete. (I wasn’t able to reproduce the bug, so I can’t confirm the fix yet. ːsteamsadː)Added an option to skip the tutorial from the menu.Added a trader who buys scrap to the first community.Made part information easier to view.Reduced the chance of tires spawning on the road.Prevented too much of the same loot from spawning in one area.

events.title: Demo Update
events.summary: A new update is now live with several fixes, tutorial improvements, and quality-of-life changes:Reduced how quickly the player gets hungry.Added a hint explaining how to charge a dead battery by pushing the car.Added a confirmation screen before sleeping.Increased the minimum energy requirement for sleeping without increasing yawning frequency.Improved the first camp tutorial to make the car parking objective clearer.Fixed tutorial progression when talking to customers and picking up a passenger
